news.title: 3 Reasons to Avoid BL and 1 Stock to Buy Instead

Costco just pulled a disappearing act on one of its shopping perks.

Costco Next — the retailer's digital-only marketplace for items you won't find in the warehouse — is gone. Members got no heads-up. Just a message pointing them to individual vendors for returns and warranty questions.

The program had been around since 2017 and was quietly growing: Costco said sales on Costco Next in one quarter of 2025 matched its entire 2022 total. Then it disappeared, with no public explanation.

Did you use Costco Next?
